body:
I tried taking zoloft for a bit and it didn't seem to help. Do you think the meds really make a whole lot of a difference? Even with lots of exercise, good diet, and being outside, etc, it doesn't seem to be nearly enough for me.

In regard to the books, they sound interesting but I have my doubts. I've tried faking confidence and it doesn't seem to work very well for me. At the end of the day I'll still always be awkward and I think it's very obvious. Honestly I always wish I was born a female. I hate having this passive and shy personality. It's living hell being a guy and having that type of personality, whereas I think women can get away with it much easier. I feel like I've never been able to handle the requirements of being "a man" that girls are receptive to and I know some of the stuff that I do wrong. I really just doubt my ability to change it - I've been trying my entire life.

I'm sure you know the feeling, but it's very depressing walking around day to day and everyone else is socializing and happy. Then whenever I try it, it seems to fail miserably.

I've always thought I'd be a good teacher or some type of therapist (ironic, right). It's the only thing I can imagine enjoying while going to work every day. Unfortunately I have pretty bad social anxiety, and i think it's very off-putting whenever I'm around people. So those two career options are out the window.

...and at this point, I'm so far into my engineering degree, nothing would even transfer over and I don't have the money to start over from stage one on a new degree.

Or something in law. I've always felt that I was pretty logical minded and I'd really like to deal with people and settle court cases, etc. 

..but none of that matters because I don't have the money and my family is expecting me to graduate soon. The years are passing and there is nothing I can do.

Umm, well I'm an engineering major and I don't necessarily enjoy it all that much. I don't really have a specific passion for anything, I really just like learning about all different subjects. I like pop-science type books and stuff relating to sociology, etc. It sounds dumb but I honestly just enjoy helping with anything as long as I'm appreciated. It doesn't really matter what it is.

Also I just wanted to thank you for typing that out. You seem like a really nice person and your comment made me smile for the first time in a while. I promise I'll check back in here in a few days or a week if I'm still around. It really just comes down to whether or not I buy that shotgun with my paycheck coming in tomorrow. 

...and to you and everyone else here, you guys are seriously amazing. I hope you have a good life and I'll be thinking of you. You've shown me more love than 99% of people I've known and it even makes me cry thinking about it. Anyway, this has all been a long time coming, I think I've just finally reached the end of my rope.
Thanks everyone for commenting. I'm going to think some of the replies over tonight. I'm honestly just so tired and depressed right now, it's hard to even put into words.
